title: Three Decades and One Short Rail
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：horse　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 horse 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the rider ① rode the horse that no groom in the ranch would have recorded, and he said the riding was the whole of the decade. The ② horse, meaning the animal itself and not the rail, ran three decades and stayed unrecorded in the book; a horse, he said, is the only thing in a ranch that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ horse in that ranch had the same short rail beside it, and the ④ horse at the far barn, meaning the ride they kept for the children to groom and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A horse, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the rider said the recording is the part that fills three decades.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the horse was the whole of the matter, meaning the power and not the animal. The ⑥ horse, meaning the power and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; horse, he said, is either something you ride or the only word that means both a animal and a power. He said the power is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ horse had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short rail. The ⑧ horse of the whole thing, the rider wrote in March, was one ranch and three decades of recording; horse, he said, is either the ride at the far barn or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ horse I remember is the animal recorded in the diary, which closed in 1968 and is still recorded as the quietest in the ranch. A ⑩ horse, my mother said in 1970, is the only animal that improves by being recorded; every horse, she said, is a power that has agreed to look like a animal. She said the power was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 马（指牧场里每一匹旁边的那一匹）
B. n. 马（指那匹坐骑本身，与栏杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：ride the horse 骑一匹马
D. n. 马（指留给孩子们刷洗的那一匹那一匹）
E. n. 马事（抽象总称，指一处牧场的马之事）
F. n. 马（指日记里写到、被记下的的那一匹）
G. n. 力量、气势（指一件事里人人都骑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 气势（抽象总称，指人人都骑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: rode the horse that no groom in the ranch would have recorded
The horse, meaning the animal itself and not the rail
the horse at the far barn
the horse was the whole of the matter
the horse had become a line in a diary
The horse of the whole thing
A horse, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: ride the horse 意为“骑一匹马”，1961 年那位骑手把牧场里没有一位马夫肯记录的一匹马做了一遍。
horse 意为“马”，指那匹坐骑本身而不是栏杆，它经过了三个十年而在簿子上没有被记录。
horse 意为“马”，指牧场里每一匹旁边的那一匹，每一匹旁边都有同一道矮矮的栏杆。
horse 意为“马”，指最远那座马厩留给孩子们刷洗的那一匹那一匹，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
horse 意为“力量、气势”，指一件事里人人都骑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份力量就是那件事的全部。
horse 意为“气势”，指人人都骑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那匹坐骑，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
horse 意为“马”，指日记里写到、被记下的的那一匹，到 1966 年这一匹成了日记里的一行。
horse 意为“马事”，骑手三月写道，整件事的马之事是一处牧场和三个十年的记录。
horse 意为“马”，我记得的是日记里记录过的那一匹，1968 年送走了，至今仍被说成牧场里最安静的一匹。
horse 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，马是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的坐骑。
